senses.sense_definition: Relating to a single person or thing as opposed to more than one.

senses.sense_definition: A person considered alone, rather than as belonging to a group of people.

examples.text: Every <w>individual</w> has the right to express their own opinion freely.

senses.sense_definition: A single organism or object distinct from a class or species.
